subject_line: An Author Spotlight for The Chamos Project
email_body:
Hi Alexis,

I came across your Author Spotlight conversation about The Chamos Project and loved the pitch of a crew of androids and humans stranded in unexplored space, with Doctor Leander Dade fighting to survive alongside the very androids who once cost him so much. Launching in February 2026 after years of work is a real milestone.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

One option I think could suit The Chamos Project is a short cinematic trailer plus a few promotional reels. If a trailer or some reels for the book is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production, with finished files for your site and social channels. It is entirely optional.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit The Chamos Project best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
